name: the UNCLASSIFIED sweep is dropped, so a new guard reaches the schema undecided
expect: a guard in the schema but not classified is caught

name: the STALE sweep is dropped, so a classification outlives the guard it described
expect: a classified guard no longer in the schema is STALE

name: the UNJUSTIFIED check is dropped, so a SEQUENCE guard need not say HOW it reconciles
expect: a SEQUENCE guard with no reconciliation note is UNJUSTIFIED

name: COVERED_BY needs only ONE token, not every one, so partial coverage passes
edits:
for token in wanted:
            if not any(token in label for label in labels):

for token in wanted[:1]:
            if not any(token in label for label in labels):
expect: COVERED_BY requires EVERY listed token, not just one

name: MUTATION_EXEMPT stops working, so an exempted guard is still demanded a mutation
expect: MUTATION_EXEMPT suppresses only the mutation requirement

name: the scope check stops comparing, so clauses may disagree again
expect: a clause reading the WIDER set is caught

name: a vanished clause reports clean instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: out.append(f"CANNOT RUN — the {kind} clause was not found in CATALOG_SQL, so its scope "
out.append(f"the {kind} clause is absent, which is fine "
expect: a clause that vanishes is CANNOT RUN, not a pass

name: the clause locator goes back to matching `select '<kind>:`, losing the distinct one
expect: every clause is located, including the `select distinct` one

name: the predicate pin stops comparing, so a narrowing filter can return
expect: re-adding the `_uq` filter is CAUGHT even though the array is unchanged
